findings.title: Data race on index counter during parallel init
findings.body: In file pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go line 189, `totalBatchesIndexed++` is executed inside `group.Go` goroutines limited by `initWorkers` with no atomic or mutex. Concurrent increments of a plain int are a data race and can undercount or trigger the race detector. Use atomic or collect counts after `group.Wait()`.

findings.title: TotalDocs reads cache map without lock
findings.body: In file pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go line 146, `TotalDocs()` iterates `b.cache` with no lock, while `BuildIndex` writes `b.cache[key]` under `cacheMu.Lock` and `GetIndex` uses `RLock`. Concurrent init builds plus `TotalDocs()` called from `searchSupport.init` log line causes concurrent map read/write, which panics in Go. Hold `RLock` in `TotalDocs`.

findings.title: Finer-grained lock allows duplicate builds for same key
findings.body: In file pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go line 137, the lock was narrowed to only the final `b.cache[key]=idx` store. Two concurrent `BuildIndex` calls for the same `NamespacedResource` now both create bleve indexes, both run the expensive builder, both `Inc` tenant metrics, and race on `bleve.New(dir)` for file-backed indexes, with the loser leaking. Need per-key singleflight or check-and-set under lock.

findings.title: Search watch loop leaks and panics on channel close
findings.body: In file pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go line 209, init creates `watchctx := context.Background()` then loops `for { v := <-events; s.handleEvent(watchctx, v) }` with no `ok` check and no `ctx.Done` select. When the SQL poller closes the stream on shutdown, the receive returns nil forever, `handleEvent` dereferences nil `evt`, and the goroutine never exits because Background is never cancelled, leaking the watcher and the underlying poller.

findings.title: Missing nil guard for IndexMetrics in watch handler
findings.body: In file pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go lines 263 and 271, `handleEvent` calls `IndexMetrics.IndexedKinds.WithLabelValues(...).Inc()/Dec()` without checking `IndexMetrics != nil`, while the same file guards every other `IndexMetrics` use. If metrics are disabled `IndexMetrics` is nil and any write event panics the search watcher goroutine.

findings.title: History/Origin panic when search disabled
findings.body: In file pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go line 925 and 930, `History` and `Origin` unconditionally dereference `s.search`, while `Search` checks for nil. When `Search.Resources` is nil `s.search` is nil and these RPCs panic with nil dereference. The removal of lazy `Init` did not add the missing guard.
